data.title: What is the Alumni Committee?
data.content: Government Polytechnic Proddatur has appointed staff members as the Committee for Alumni. The committee is responsible for alumni-related activities and coordination.

data.title: Who is the Alumni Committee Coordinator?
data.content: P. Gurumurthy Reddy, Head of Civil Engineering, is appointed as the Coordinator of the Alumni Committee at Government Polytechnic Proddatur.

data.title: Who are the members of the Alumni Committee?
data.content: The Alumni Committee consists of P. Gurumurthy Reddy as Coordinator, A. Siva Shankar as Member, M.J.P. Vara Prakash as Member, V. Chandra Sekhar Reddy as Member, K. Narasimha Raju as Member, V. Venkata Subbaiah as Member, P. Gangadharam as Member, B. Naga Siva Prasad Reddy as Member, and Y.V.M. Devarayulu as Member.

data.title: Who is P. Gurumurthy Reddy in the Alumni Committee?
data.content: P. Gurumurthy Reddy is the Head of Civil Engineering and serves as the Coordinator of the Alumni Committee.

data.title: Who is A. Siva Shankar in the Alumni Committee?
data.content: A. Siva Shankar is the Head of Electrical & Electronics Engineering at GPT, Simhadripuram, and serves as a Member of the Alumni Committee.
